## Installation

1. Download and install the [GTA San Andreas Widescreen Fix](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#gtasa) - it includes the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader) - or install the ASI Loader on its own.
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for GTA San Andreas](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/gtasa/GTASA.XboxRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` file into the `scripts` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- The water and the blood the game spawns as particles leave drops on the camera as well, see `BloodDrops` in the settings.
- Change the settings on [fusionfix.io](https://fusionfix.io) or in FusionFixHub; changes apply while the game runs. They are stored in the `.cfg` next to the plugin.
